description: This file defines schemas related to tools and adapters within the Pipecat framework, including classes such as ToolsSchema and enumeration AdapterType, and manages standard and custom tool configurations for function calling.

classes.name: AdapterType
classes.description: Enum representing supported adapter types for custom tools, specifically GEMINI and SHIM.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Class providing schema management for both standard and custom function calling tools within the Pipecat framework.

methods.name: None __init__( self, standard_tools: List[FunctionSchema | DirectFunction], custom_tools: Optional[Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None, )
methods.description: Constructor for ToolsSchema, initializes with lists of standard tools and optional custom tools for different adapter types.

methods.name: List[FunctionSchema] standard_tools(self)
methods.description: Property getter that returns the list of standard FunctionSchema tools.

methods.name: Dict[AdapterType,List[Dict[str,Any]]] custom_tools(self)
methods.description: Property getter that returns the dictionary of custom tools mapped by AdapterType.

methods.name: None custom_tools(self, value: Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]])
methods.description: Property setter that updates the custom tools dictionary.

ctags.name: GEMINI
ctags.pattern: /^    GEMINI = "gemini"  # that is the only service where we are able to add custom tools for now$/

ctags.name: SHIM
ctags.pattern: /^    SHIM = "shim"  # for use as backward compatibility shim for creating ToolsSchemas from list /

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, standard_tools: List[FunctionSchema | DirectFunction], custom_tools: Optional[Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None, )

ctags.name: custom_tools
ctags.pattern: /^    def custom_tools(self, value: Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) -> None:$/

fields.name: GEMINI = "gemini"  # that is the only service where we are able to add custom tools for now
